dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: Hehe~ As long as I stick to the exploration plan and get to know all the places and things in Snezhnaya, I'm sure I'll become someone truly strong someday!

choices.text: About Katheryne's statues and gifts...

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Hehe, they're pretty, aren't they?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: This set of Lady Katheryne statues is limited edition, you know! They cost a fortune to commission from some amazing artists and craftsmen...

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Some senior adventurers even hid theirs inside blocks of ice, while others mailed them back and forth to trade.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: They became so popular that the distributor and the Guild even switched to a special Fervor Coupon lottery for the statue parts.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: And getting my hands on these coupons and parts took so, so much work... They cost me almost half a lifetime's worth of snack money!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: But thanks to that, everyone in the Mutual Aid Network can put together their very own Lady Katheryne, just the way they like.

choices.text: Lady... Katheryne?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Huh? Isn't Lady Katheryne... the one in charge at the Adventurers' Guild?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: I heard all adventurers have to do what she says, and she's the one who gives out all the commissions.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: And once everything is done, Lady Katheryne even hands out the rewards herself.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: So that must mean she has information on every adventurer in Teyvat, plus all their reward money...

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Isn't that super impressive?

choices.text: You really admire Katheryne, don't you?
About the exploration plan...

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Are you a little worried? You don't think my plan is reliable?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: I've had people doubt me before, too — "What could anyone possibly learn from a kid's plan?"

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Well, let me tell you: my exploration plan is based on the materials Talalikhin left behind!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: And his materials draw on the experience of all sorts of adventurers and hunters, and even on grenadier training manuals!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: See? I may just be a kid, but at least my sources are totally reliable.

choices.text: Is he really that impressive?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Hmm... Depends who you're using as the standard. Ajax from my village could beat fifty Talalikhins in a minute... No, eighty!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: You've heard of Ajax, right?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Then again, if I could ever last two whole seconds against him, I'd be so happy I'd wake up laughing!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: For an ordinary person like me, making it to Talalikhin's level is probably enough. No getting greedy.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Talalikhin works at the Adventurers' Guild headquarters now. I hear he's pretty important there, too!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: So if you hurry up and become a proper adventurer, maybe you'll get to meet him in Snezhnograd someday!

choices.text: Is Talalikhin really that strong?
Why don't we talk about you?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Me? There isn't much to tell...

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: My family are just ordinary fishermen. If I don't get stronger, I'll probably just keep fishing for the rest of my life, too.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: There's nothing wrong with fishing... It just doesn't give you much to look forward to.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: The most successful person in my family is my older sister, who's almost twenty years older than me.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Her name is Budanova. When I was too little to remember anything, she joined the Fatui with honor because she was so amazingly fit and strong.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Later on, she even got to serve under a powerful Harbinger and went off to Fontaine!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: But she's been so, so busy with work that she hasn't come home in ages. I'm starting to forget what she looks like...

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: So I just keep writing letters to my sister. She sends me lots and lots of spending money with every letter, and even asks her friends in Snezhnaya to buy me pretty clothes!

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: I bought this outfit with the Mora she sent me. Pretty, isn't it?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Once I get a little stronger, I'm going to show up in Fontaine wearing this and surprise her!

choices.text: Do you want to join the Fatui too?

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: No. My sister told me that if we both walked the same path, life would be a lot less interesting.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: She told our parents I had all sorts of choices. I could try being a professional musket sharpshooter, a geographic surveyor, a sailor, or an adventurer...

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Adventuring is still the one I'm most interested in, but I don't want to limit myself to just one set of skills.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: A friend I met recently, Da Xi'er, taught me a Liyue proverb: "You can never have too many skills."

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Learning all sorts of things is a kind of strength too, and maybe one day, I'll be able to help my sister in ways she'd never expect!

choices.text: Do you want to work with your sister?
Let's chat again later.

response.speaker: Chichikova
response.text: Going to get some work done? Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
dialogues.text: Oh my gosh... T-T-T-Tumaini!? Are you on a secret mission? Is that why you have to keep your identity hidden?

dialogues.speaker: Little Pinecone
dialogues.text: Is there anything we can do to help? We may not be very strong, but if you have a task for us, we'll give it everything we've got!

choices.text: Then here's your task: let's all grow stronger together.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: Th-Then we've already begun! We've been training hard, and we won't let you down!

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Chichikova told us to use the Kamera to observe all kinds of little animals, so we went and learned from the hunters how to get close without startling them...

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: That skill is called "stealth," right? The warriors of the Masters of the Night-Wind are really good at it. Maybe we could even use it in competitions!

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: A-And, and! We've been taking the manual with us and going all over the place, but there's so much deep snow on the roads, and the blizzards are super strong...

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: So we need to get used to the cold, too! And we have to learn how to use lots of new ice sculptures!

choices.text: Why don't you tell me a little about yourselves first?

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: Um... W-We're on a training trip.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: Little Pinecone's dad — Uncle Amuru, the Sand Dagger of Seit'aad — taught us lots of fighting moves.

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: But Dad said since we've always stayed in Natlan, we don't know enough about warriors from other places, and that won't do.

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: So he gave us a great big bunch of travel money and sent us all the way to Snezhnaya for some serious training.

choices.text: He let two kids travel all the way to another country by themselves...?

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: H-Hey, we're not little kids anymore! I'm already twelve, and Little Pinecone is ten!

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: They say Varesa from the Collective of Plenty had already beaten hundreds of monsters when she was our age.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: Just a few more years, and we'll be official tribal warriors too, like Kinich and Lord Ajaw!

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: This trip is just for training, really. We only followed Chichikova around and practiced boxing and wrestling with a few big white bears.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: We didn't pick fights with anyone super scary, so we'll be totally fine!

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Dad says if you stay in a nice, comfy place all the time, your body and brain both get slow.

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Da Xi'er also said people in Liyue work hard with a certain kind of attitude... Umm... what was the word for it again?

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: ...Being ready for danger, even during peaceful times?

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Right, right! That's the one!

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: If we're always ready for bad guys to pop up, and we keep training as hard as we can, then we won't panic when something really bad happens.

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: And next time Natlan needs more warriors, Wood Figure and I are both gonna step up and help!

choices.text: Your dad's got some serious nerve...
No worries. I won't interrupt your fun.

response.speaker: "Flammabomb Wood Figure"
response.text: W-Wait! I... I don't mind being interrupted by Tumaini...

response.speaker: Little Pinecone
response.text: Hmm... But Tumaini still seems busy... When you have time later, please come play with us! Even if it's only for a few minutes!

dialogues.speaker: Big Xi'er
dialogues.text: Hello there, Honorary Knight Tumaini! What a surprise, running into you here.

choices.text: What are you doing?

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: It's called "circulating qi to ward off the cold."

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Or, to put it simply, tempering the will.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Enduring extreme cold in only thin clothes is a classic martial arts discipline, and I'm just about starting to master it!

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Of course, compared to Master Huo in his prime, I still have a long way to go...

choices.text: Master Huo...? Who's that?

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: I've only heard about his fame from my master's stories.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Master Huo was a renowned swordsman who also knew the art of forging weapons.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: His treasured blade was called "Unseen Razor," and with it, he struck down many evils. Even now, the martial world still tells stories of his deeds.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Lately, though, people have been telling a different version of the story. They say Master Huo's growing fame made him realize his heart had become restless, so he went looking for somewhere cold and secluded, far away from worldly noise.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: He kept heading north across Teyvat, and in the end, vanished into Snezhnaya's snowstorms...

choices.text: Sounds pretty mysterious.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Though, I should probably add that Master Huo's younger sister came forward a couple of weeks ago to clear the air. She said the story had been exaggerated far too much, and asked everyone to stop spreading it around.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: And since my master lost to her ten years ago — and she's coming to Snezhnaya soon herself — I'd rather not say any more.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: I'll just focus on training, steady my mind, and keep improving myself, like a proper martial artist should...

choices.text: The sword's name sounds kind of familiar.
I've never heard of him.
You look like you're from Liyue. Why call me by all those titles?

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Well, my little sister lived in Mondstadt for years. Whenever we all got together, she'd go on and on about the food there, the Knights of Favonius, and all kinds of stories from Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Then I even caught a glimpse of you from afar during the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge, though I'm sure you didn't notice me.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Later, after I bought several cartloads of fruits and Grainfruit from Bold Bang Bouldern, she invited me to Natlan, where I heard a whole new batch of heroic tales about you.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: So with two grand titles like that, why not combine them? It makes you sound even more impressive — exactly the kind of title a legendary martial-world master deserves.

choices.text: So you haven't told Chichikova?

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Well, wouldn't it be more interesting to let her see a legendary martial-world master's skills firsthand, instead of just hearing about them from someone else?

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Besides, Chichikova might not know all the legends from other lands. Even people who've traveled somewhere can miss a tale or two.

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Take my master, for example. Have you ever heard of Huangshan, Demon-Slayer of the Flying Leaf?

choices.text: I can't say I have... Who's that?

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Exactly! Teyvat is vast, and there are skilled masters in every corner of it. No one could possibly know them all.

choices.text: I've heard the name, but that's about it.
You're helping me keep a low profile?
We'll talk more later!

response.speaker: Big Xi'er
response.text: Take care. I'll get back to circulating my qi.

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: So, what are your plans next?

dialogues.speaker: Big Xi'er
dialogues.text: I heard there's a huge snowy mountain to the southeast. The conditions there are extremely harsh — definitely not ordinary. I'd like to go test myself there...

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: Sure, but I'm not very familiar with that area. The adults in my village also warned us never to go too close.

dialogues.speaker: Chichikova
dialogues.text: Just promise you'll only take a quick look from a distance, okay? And then come right back!
